themes.description: Users report that recent app updates have introduced a confusing interface, critical bugs in order placement, and loss of real‑time data, leading to incorrect trade execution and frustration.
themes.business_impact: Users are losing money on trades, abandoning the app, and considering switching brokers, which directly impacts revenue, increases support cost, and threatens customer acquisition goals.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Rapid iteration without thorough regression testing caused UI re‑design changes to break order validation and data feeds, while insufficient UX research left the interface non‑intuitive for existing users.
themes.action_plan:
• 1. Deploy a rollback to the previous stable UI version while a dedicated task force investigates the order execution bugs
• 2. Rebuild the order flow with end‑to‑end automated tests and include user journey testing
• 3. Conduct a rapid UX audit with focus groups to redesign confusing elements
• 4. Implement real‑time data streaming verification for all securities
• 5. Release a phased update with clear rollback options and monitor trade accuracy metrics
